bug_1_file_deletion.backend: ✅ API correctly handles removeBytes parameter. Files are removed from /root/wsx-store when removeBytes=true, kept when removeBytes=false
bug_1_file_deletion.frontend: ⚠️ Could not fully test library delete dialog UI (no file cards visible), but backend confirms functionality works
bug_1_file_deletion.notes: The implementation in cloud-store.ts correctly handles both scenarios: (1) removeBytes=true with relPath deletes from disk, (2) removeBytes=true without relPath calls dropObject, (3) removeBytes=false keeps file on disk

bug_2_context_menu.findings: ✅ Context menu positioned correctly at cursor location (within 1px tolerance). Menu appears at (1391, 421) when cursor at (1392, 422). Scale calculation using offsetWidth/rect.width works correctly at 100% scale.
bug_2_context_menu.notes: The fix in mail-context-menu.tsx using createPortal to document.body and scale calculation (el.offsetWidth ? r.width / el.offsetWidth : 1) correctly handles zoom. Menu positioning logic accounts for screen edges and flips menu when needed.

bug_3_code_link_extraction.findings: ✅ Code/link extraction working correctly: QA1 (no code, has link), QA2 (code 483920, has link), QA3 (no code, no link). The extractCode function in mail-format.ts now requires CODE_WORDS context, preventing false positives from zip codes (94111, 101000).
bug_3_code_link_extraction.notes: The implementation correctly distinguishes between verification codes and other numbers. QA1's zip code 94111 is not extracted as a code. QA2's code 483920 is correctly identified. Code pills in message list show code in preview text.

regression_checks.mail_screen: ✅ Loads and displays temp mailbox correctly
regression_checks.email_scrolling: ✅ Email iframe loads and displays content
